انبلعوا (form VII)
# اِنْبَلَعُوا (inbalaʕū) /in.ba.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# اِنْبَلِعُوا (inbaliʕū) /in.ba.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
